test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is true?

a) Every trapezium is a parallelogram.

b) Every parallelogram is a square.

c) Every rectangle is a square.

d) Every square is a rhombus.
solution:
**Given:**

a) Every trapezium is a parallelogram.

b) Every parallelogram is a square.

c) Every rectangle is a square.

d) Every square is a rhombus.

**Concept:** 

**a) Every trapezium is a parallelogram.**

Trapezium - It is a quadrilateral that has at least one pair of parallel sides.

Parallelogram - It is a quadrilateral that has two pairs of parallel sides.

Thus, **All Trapezium are not Parallelogram** but Every Parallelogram can be Trapezium.

**b) Every parallelogram is a square.**

Square - All sides are equal.

Parallelogram - It is a quadrilateral that has two pairs of parallel sides.

thus, **Not all parallelograms can be square.**

**c) Every rectangle is a square.**

Rectangle - It has length and breadth all at right angles to each other, and is a parallelogram.

Square - All sides are equal.

Thus, Every rectangle is not a square.

**d) Every square is a rhombus.**

Square - All sides are equal and at right angles to each other.

Rhombus - It is a Flat shape with four equal sides and four angles.

If you have a Rhombus with four equal interior angles, you have a square. A square is a special case of rhombus because it has four equal-length sides and goes above and beyond that to have four right angles.

**Thus, the correct answer is 'Every square is a rhombus'*.***
